coincidence.songTitle: It’s All Over Now, Baby Blue
coincidence.line: Take what you have gathered from coincidence
stanza: The highway is for gamblers, better use your sense
Take what you have gathered from coincidence
The empty-handed painter from your streets
Is drawing crazy patterns on your sheets
The sky, too, is folding under you
And it's all over now, Baby Blue

coincidence.songTitle: Something About What Happens When We Talk
stanza: Or was it meant to be?
Well now old Dien is gone and dead
All the new leaders are anti-red
Against Red China, the United Nations
Now all the news commentators and the CIA
